steps.instruction: Sign in to Snipe-IT at http://127.0.0.1:8098/ with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type that exact text). Then go to Assets list, search for assets whose name starts with 'Seed:', and report each asset's name and asset tag exactly as shown.

In Snipe-IT, create a new asset named '{{runid}} Bench Asset', model 'Bench Laptop Model' (choose from searchable dropdown), status label 'Ready to Deploy', default location 'Bench Office', purchase date 2026-03-15. Save it, then check it out to user 'Bench Assignee' with a note containing '{{runid}}'. Finally report the asset's asset tag exactly as displayed (e.g. BA-000XX).

Verify on the page: model is 'Bench Laptop Model', status 'Ready to Deploy' (deployed status may show as 'Checked out' — report the actual status label shown, but confirm status was set to Ready to Deploy), location 'Bench Office', purchase date 2026-03-15, and it is checked out to user 'Bench Assignee' with a checkout note containing '{{runid}}'. Report each of these values as actually shown.
